awards.title: Chi Chapter charter
awards.detail: University of Tampa recognized as Chi Chapter—the first pre-health fraternity on campus.

awards.title: Emma N. Huffman Chapter Project Grant
awards.detail: $1,150 grant for a chapter service project benefiting the local community (named for USF founder Emma Huffman).

awards.title: Distinguished Individual Award
awards.detail: $400 for a brother who embodies the pillars—usable for conferences, exam prep, or application fees.

awards.title: Global Giving Grant
awards.detail: $1,000 to help 1–3 members travel abroad for a service project.

milestones.title: Chi Chapter established at the University of Tampa
milestones.detail: First pre-health fraternity on campus; mission centered on scholarship, brotherhood, service, and underserved Tampa communities.

milestones.title: Adopted Gift of Life as chapter philanthropy focus
milestones.detail: Aligning with MED’s national partnership—donor drives and blood-cancer advocacy.

milestones.title: Launching Fall Rush & programming calendar
milestones.detail: Info sessions, MCAT cohorts, speaker series, and Tampa Bay service partners.

outings.title: Chapter kickoff & mentorship circles
outings.detail: Welcome dinner and small-group mentoring for the founding Chi class.

outings.title: Gift of Life donor drive
outings.detail: Campus swab drive with education on bone marrow donation.

outings.title: End-of-semester dinner
outings.detail: Recognition for scholarship and service hour milestones.
